LanguageData.MXZL_ZhaoliMurmurQuest.questDescriptionR:
questDescription->After the colony has endured enough days and deaths, something beyond the threshold has finally pried open a seam. A being entangled with life, corpses, and karma sends you a single message through that rift.

If you are willing to listen, a temporary site named "Hideout of the Nonexistent" will appear near your settlement. Zhaoli waits there for an exchange, a delayed answer, or a refusal that tears the matter apart completely.

After accepting this quest, a temporary site will appear near your colony. Reach it and resolve the matter within 3 days. If you accept the quest and ignore it, Zhaoli will attack the colony directly. Her raid can be extremely difficult before you are prepared or before the game has reached the mid-to-late stage, so accept with care.
LanguageData.MXZL_ZhaoliReturnQuest.questDescriptionR: questDescription->Zhaoli has made her answer. Whether it first came through herbal medicine, a corpse, or a slaughter between you and her, it has followed the same thread back here.\n\nIf you accept her, Zhaoli will formally join the colony after today.
